lastCompletedStory.title: Re-measure and re-record the container lane from a real Docker run

nextStoryContext: Container lane in test/helpers/lane-expectations.json is now re-recorded from an ACTUAL `bun scripts/test-in-container.ts` run against the already-running cam-worker container on 2026-07-28: 5721 pass / 0 fail / 40 skip, exit 0. expectedSkips left at 40 (matched exactly, unchanged from the prior record). passFloor set to 5500 (rounded down to a multiple of 100, leaving a 221-pass gap, comfortably clear of MIN_PASS_FLOOR_HEADROOM=50 from US-001). measuredVia carries the measuredAt date (2026-07-28), the exact command (`bun scripts/test-in-container.ts`), and the token form '5721 pass / 0 fail / 40 skip'. Verified real (not narrated): ran the container gate BEFORE the edit (printed 'too tight' failure against the stale passFloor 5691, headroom only 30) and AFTER the edit (printed 'container lane: 40 skip (matches recorded expectation)', exit 0) -- honest red-then-green in the same story. Both AC1 and AC4 oracle one-liners were run directly and both exited 0 (container and host lanes independently). Docker was confirmed up (29.4.0) and the cam-worker container was already running (reused, no ensure-up needed). Host lane (US-001's record) was left completely untouched -- diff is a single file, container object only. `bun run typecheck`, `bun test` (5761 pass / 0 fail, host lane), and `bun run check:all` (all gates, including `check:skip-ratchet` on the host lane) are all green. No external library was touched (pure JSON fixture re-record + re-running the existing container-lane gate script), so Step 5.5 is a no-op for this story, same as US-001.
